AccountPassword.description: A secret-bearing password value. Debug output is always redacted.

CatalogEntry.description: Server-confirmed sales projection. Private definitions and cost dependencies never occur here.

CatalogRevision.description: One scoped definition. Calculated costs are checked against stored dependencies.

CatalogSyncIssue.description: Repair information for a Manager. The rejected payload and server response stay in Rust storage.

ConfirmDiscountApproval.description: Only the authenticated Rust engine sends a validated persisted snapshot for promotion.

ConfirmPrice.description: Authenticated engine-to-server proposal. The server assigns revision and time.

costYer.description: Internal catalog cost. The server checks this against its stored revision; public snapshots omit it.

DesktopSignInRequest.description: Password input is transient and must never be logged or persisted by a shell.

categoryName.description: Category name at this revision, retained for historical reads.

notes.description: Internal notes are only exposed to Managers.

colorIds.description: Empty means all options of the corresponding kind are compatible.

forNewWork.description: New work requires the current revision and an active furniture, category, and variant.
New work requires the current revision and an active product, category, and variant.

currentCostYer.description: Non-negative whole Yemeni rials per selected unit.

MaterialQuantity.description: Exact positive decimal quantity with no more than six fractional digits.

source.description: Exact accepted quotation, including its issued prices and customer snapshot.

currentCost.description: Advisory current cost; commercial references resolve the immutable part snapshot instead.

catalogSyncIssues.description: Unresolved catalog transfer failures, returned only to an authorized Manager.

categoryName.description: Category name at this revision, retained for historical reads.

notes.description: Internal notes are withheld with purchase costs.

purchaseCostYer.description: Omitted entirely when the caller cannot read internal purchase costs.

PublishedPrice.description: Immutable public snapshot. Contains no purchase cost, margin, BOM, or notes.

remote.description: Retained authoritative input; the local snapshot remains visible.

serverAvailable.description: Cache evaluation is never evidence that issuance can succeed online.

totals.description: Present only when every field and checked calculation is valid.

permittedActions.description: Derived from the authenticated actor and current server state, never client role flags.

oneOf.description: Cached projections must be cleared and queried again after a policy change.

SynchronizeCatalogRevisions.description: A dependency-ordered bounded batch; replay never changes an accepted revision.

UploadCatalogImage.description: Rust-only network boundary; the native shell cannot submit image content.
